decision_record.transfer: Absorption timing edge on 4h LINKUSDT bars: forced sellers on the shock bar pay for immediacy; the confirmation surplus decays after the confirming close — a late entry buys the same fixed 16h hold at a stale close after the information is public.
decision_record.comparison: Price-aware baseline = the pre-change sleeve itself (shadow control, ENH-B8 aster_edge_journal): enters on the latest completed bar's signal at any age.
decision_record.mechanism: Stale-signal entry leak: no entry window — entries fired at any signal age (measured 12h stale, 3 unseen 4h bars) sized off the stale close into a fixed 16h hold.
decision_record.calculation: signal_age_h = (now - (signal_bar_t + 4h)) / 3600. Pre-change measurement (ENH-B8): 12/12 b11/b12 LINK sleeves entered on a 12h-stale signal bar. Treatment refuses age > 4h (one full bar interval: at least one newer completed bar exists that the snapshot never showed, so neither the confirmation nor the price_hint is verifiable).
decision_record.experiment: Pre-registered: fresh (age 0) enters ON and OFF identically; stale (age 12h) enters OFF, refused ON; deadline exit at stale age still fires ON. Rejection rule: any fresh divergence or gated exit kills it. Blockers: tests/test_harden_edge_batch7_blockers.py::TestLinkFreshnessGate + batch-8 blockers (fail-first proven there).
